{"code": "import numpy as np

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify no NaNs remain
nan_after_clean = sales_df['revenue_clean'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Number of NaNs after cleaning: {nan_after_clean}')

# Now check the 'status' column to ensure we are only considering 'completed' orders
status_counts = sales_df['status'].value_counts()
print('\nStatus value counts:\n', status_counts)

# Check for any remaining invalid revenue entries
invalid_revenue_clean = sales_df[sales_df['revenue_clean'].isnull()]
print('\nRows with invalid revenue after cleaning:\n', invalid_revenue_clean[['order_id', 'revenue']])"}
